## The basic commands {.smaller}

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width=48%}
- `git clone <repo> [<dir>]`
  - Clone a repository into a new directory

- `git status`
  - Check the state of the local workspace

- `git add <filepath>`
  - Update the index with any changes

- `git commit`
  - `git commit -m <message>`
  - Commit changes in the index to (local) record 
:::
::: {.column width=2%}
:::
::: {.column width=50%}
- `git push <remote> <branch>`
  - Send your locally committed changes to the remote repo

- `git pull <remote> <branch>`
  - Get changes from the remote repo locally

::: {style="text-align: center;"}
![]( images/git_spaces_2.png ){width=80%}
:::
:::
::::


## Branches {.smaller}

Branches help in both individual and collaborative work, e.g.

::: {style="font-size: 85%;"}
- Modifying the same files as someone else?
- Working on different features in parallel?
:::

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width=50%}
```{mermaid}
    %%{init: {'theme': 'base',
              'gitGraph': {'rotateCommitLabel': true},
              'themeVariables': {
                  'commitLabelBackground': '#bbbbbb',
                  'commitLabelColor': '#ffffff'
    } } }%%
    gitGraph
       commit id: "4-ff6b"
       commit id: "0-fd7f"
       commit id: "fea 1.a"
       commit id: "fea 1.b"
       commit id: "fea 1.c"
       commit id: "fea 1.d"
       commit id: "5-af6f"
```

Conduct development in branches and merged into main when completed:

```{mermaid}
    %%{init: {'theme': 'base',
              'gitGraph': {'rotateCommitLabel': true},
              'themeVariables': {
                  'commitLabelBackground': '#bbbbbb',
                  'commitLabelColor': '#ffffff'
    } } }%%
    gitGraph
       commit id: "4-ff6b"
       commit id: "0-fd7f"
       branch feature_1
       commit id: "fea 1.a"
       commit id: "fea 1.b"
       checkout main
       branch feature_2
       commit id: "fea 2.a"
       checkout feature_1
       commit id: "fea 1.c"
       checkout main
       merge feature_1
       checkout feature_2
       commit id: "fea 2.b"
       checkout main
       merge feature_2
       commit id: "5-af6f"
       commit id: "1-ad4e"
```
:::
::: {.column width=50%}

- `git branch <branchname>`
  - Creates new branch _branchname_ from current point
- `git checkout <branchname>`
  - move workspace to _branchname_
- `git merge <branchname>`
  - Tie _branchname_ into the current checked out branch with a merge
    commit.
:::
::::
